title: Mobile UI pass — before/after evidence at phone + desktop viewports

used: frontend-design — restraint; responsive down to mobile is a quality floor; spend boldness once; do not decorate
ui-styling — mobile-first responsive; max-width queries; accessible touch targets; use design tokens
design-system — reuse the existing semantic CSS variables; never hardcode raw hex
chosen_patterns: max-width media queries at 768px (mobile) with a 640-768px refinement band; desktop >=769px untouched
sidebar (fixed 220px column) -> full-width static top bar with horizontally scrollable nav
stat cards stack full-width; view-header/header-actions wrap
wide tables keep .table-wrap horizontal scroll with a 640px min-width so columns stay readable
touch targets >=40px for buttons, nav links, tabs, check rows
reused existing tokens (--card, --border, --accent, --muted, --watching-bg...); zero new hardcoded colors

changed_files.change: appended two responsive media-query blocks (+103 lines); every pre-existing desktop rule untouched

capture_method.primary_intended: on-device screenshots of the running APK on Waydroid at 390x844 (waydroid CLI per AMENDMENT-1)
capture_method.used_fallback: headless Google Chrome (CDP) rendering the real Flask app served from repo src/ at an emulated 390x844 viewport
capture_method.why_fallback: the local GNOME graphics session was LOCKED for the whole of P1-P3 (loginctl LockedHint=yes, org.gnome.ScreenSaver.GetActive=true, lock shield visible at 04:43 and 04:54). A locked screen shows only the shield, so no on-device screenshot is possible and synthetic input would type into the lock password field. This is the contingency the stage brief pre-authorised ('if session locked, capture via WebView window resize and SAY SO').
capture_method.note: the same responsive CSS is what the APK's WebView renders; the bundled asset was verified identical (see apk.bundled_theme_css_sha256)

device.install: waydroid app install (native CLI, AMENDMENT-1); 'DK Bond Tracker' present in waydroid app list
device.on_device_screenshot: NOT POSSIBLE (graphics session locked; no adb bridge, no root for waydroid shell/logcat)

apk.bundled_theme_css_note: assets/chaquopy/app.imy :: src/static/theme.css is byte-identical to the repo file after the pass — the APK carries the new responsive UI

desktop_parity.conclusion: C2 desktop parity holds — the pass is pixel-identical at >=769px

observations.before: at 390px the fixed 220px sidebar consumed >55% of the width and pushed all content off-screen; the 4-column Add Candidate form crushed inputs to ~55px; stat cards overflowed; tables squeezed columns to ~130px
observations.after: nav is a full-width top bar; content is full-width; stat cards stack; the form and the move panel have usable input widths; tables scroll horizontally with readable columns

limitations: No on-device screenshot: graphics session locked throughout; adb bridge unavailable; waydroid shell/logcat need root (not available).
The 5 'remote'-marked tests are deselected locally (that is the '499' collection total: 494 local + 5 remote).
mobile-mcp was not usable: it needs an adb device and none is exposed for this Waydroid container.
